name: Sketch hand drawn
summary: Organic hand-drawn visual storytelling: chalk/pencil container lines draw on around key concepts, supported by organic accents and human craft.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
stiff geometric grids without organic stroke modulation
abrupt scene cuts without morph continuity

frame_checklist: Every container exhibits stroke taper and organic rough curvature
Draw-on paths complete precisely as the spoken anchor word sounds
Safezone margins maintain minimum 460px bottom and 190px right padding
Text labels retain high legibility despite organic border aesthetic
licence_notes: Original procedural SVG pathing; zero copyrighted stock assets.
